articles.title: DTCC moves tokenized securities into live trading, marking a milestone for Wall Street's blockchain push
articles.snippet: DTCC's first live production trades using tokenized securities show how blockchain could reshape the infrastructure behind Wall Street.

articles.title: Cantor and Securitize collaborate on blockchain-based IPOs
articles.snippet: The move creates a pathway for public companies to raise capital onchain and issue tokenized securities.

articles.title: Ostium suffers $18 million exploit as oracle attack wave continues to hit DeFi
articles.snippet: A hacker used Ostium's own price-reporting infrastructure against the protocol, submitting falsified future-dated oracle data to manufacture fake trading profits and trigger an $18 million payout.

articles.title: The privacy paradox of protecting kids online
articles.snippet: We don’t need to imagine the privacy pitfalls of age verification. They’ve been happening for years, argues Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard.

articles.title: President Trump expected to meet with senators to work on ethics concerns in crypto bill
articles.snippet: The most contentious piece of the crypto market structure bill is unresolved in the final weeks of Senate runway, and the president is expected to discuss it.
